stem:
Divya compares writing large numbers with a new landmark symbol for every power, versus using place value.

Which claim correctly explains place-value numerals?

options.text: Place value still works if each digit keeps a fixed absolute value in every position.
Writing a new landmark symbol for each power is what creates place value.
The same digit can mean ones or sixties depending on its position, so no new symbol is needed for each landmark.
Place value is found by squaring a digit's position number.

teacher.key_rationale: Place value assigns meaning by position, so the same compact symbols cover many landmarks. A drops the position condition. B reverses landmark symbols and place value. D replaces linear place powers with squaring.
